name: 13584-sharedprefix-nemotronnano9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off -- one GPU, one node.
architecture: NemotronHForCausalLM, 8.89B parameters, bf16, 56 layers (27 recurrent, 4 self-attention, 25 MLP), hidden 4480, vocab 131072, ~16.6 GiB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=5, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 500 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn: fifty distinct 10240-token preambles (prefix_count: 50), each request drawing one of them plus a 256-token question of its own and generating 128 tokens. Fixed lengths, temperature 0.0, seed 13584; 500 requests, ten per preamble.
purpose: A nine-billion-parameter help desk assistant answering short questions on fifty long shared manuals, five concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit 35ba6fe19eca20e159d25762b296332d635396dd (v0.5.6).
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. An indented block is dropped
# silently, so every value here must stay on one line.
model-path: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2
tp-size: 1
# mem-fraction-static is left to the engine: at this version an explicit value skips the step that
# reads the model config, and this architecture then fails while parsing its arguments.
context-length: 16384

# Load-bearing: the server does not start on this card without it. Do not reach for
# --max-mamba-cache-size instead -- there is an open crash report against setting it
# (TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable, memory_pool.py:306).
max-running-requests: 64

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
random-seed: 13584
